implemented_boundaries: Import/help remain side-effect free. All tracked current/Git packet bytes, external source identities, archives and the closed transitive helper chain are pinned before helper execution or resource creation.

Only one fresh source target receives canonical genuine Prisma deployment. Original-grantor finalization and full source-derived native/expression/ledger comparison precede synthetic fixtures. Restored data never receives initdb, bootstrap, application installation or migration.

Fresh seven-file external history is produced through the reviewed pure history helper. Source commit/tree/full packet remain unpinned and review remains pending in preparer output; old repository history is never edited or adopted.

Bootstrap and finalizer read, verify and execute the exact same pinned bytes. Source and restored password controls use private pgpass files; no actual password enters argv, process environment or exported evidence.

Issuer commits are independently acknowledged and closed. Actual trigger-generated created_at/expires_at remain private; all 21 actual grant claims are independently compared, including issuer mutation xid, actual target tuple and exact capability fields. Canonical decimal generations are strictly normalized to bigint representation before session creation.

Quiescence permits only postgres normal and physical-replication login. Every one of 16 fixed backup-safety Boolean fields and the hashed system identity is required; missing or additional fields fail closed.

Real pinned 17.11 pg_basebackup streams WAL with SHA256 manifest. Source pg_verifybackup and separate fresh staging pg_verifybackup both precede target startup. Staging verifies archive hash, safe regular members, required PG/WAL files, source HBA and inert auto.conf; extraction never initializes a database.

Host archive and bootstrap secrets stay under owner-only DACL; archive has a single hardlink. Protected backup contents, role verifiers and raw catalog function bodies are not exported. Target ownership uses observed image postgres uid/gid.

All 42 table hashes/counts, business rows, source-qualified native/ledger and role/membership/database authority must match before restoration transitions. Permanent migrator membership remains distinct from the three temporary leaf memberships.

Six independent restored credentials are rotated. Actual clearly synthetic Identity revoke/recover receipts run before other restored service login. Five finite currentness/SELECT diagnostics retain unchanged grant rows, exact old tuple and unexpired grant prerequisites, then return to admin-only quarantine.

Every unexpected result stops. Global all-other-client checks and actual operation closure precede catalog observations; fixed diagnostics and typed evidence exclude raw passwords, token handles, backend pids/xids and stderr.

Cleanup verifies exact captured CID/name/run labels and volume name/CreatedAt/run labels. Container removal uses immutable CID. Each owned cleanup is attempted independently; inventory failure cannot prove absence. Only the two exact host private files are deleted, followed by independent absence checks; cached image and unrelated resources remain.

Tracked packet, ignored tool-data files, all four external sources, nested fresh manifests, all seven source snapshot files and both archives are rehashed after cleanup. Source drift cannot leave a successful qualification pointer.
plain_english: The toy database copy plan is ready for another reviewer. It checks the copy twice, changes its keys and keeps it locked. We have only tested the plan with pretend processes; we have not made or opened a real copy.
